an4.186:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca :
an4.186:1.2: kena nu kho bhante loko nīyati, kena loko parikissati, kassa ca uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatīti?
an4.186:2.2: bhaddako kho te bhikkhu ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
an4.186:2.4: kena nu kho bhante loko nīyati, kena loko parikissati, kassa ca uppannassa vasaṃ gacchatīti.
an4.186:2.6: cittena kho bhikkhu loko nīyati, cittena parikissati, cittassa uppannassa vasaṃ gacchati.
an4.186:3.1: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ apucchi :
an4.186:3.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bahussuto dhammadharo hotīti?
an4.186:4.2: bhaddako te bhikkhu ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
an4.186:4.4: bahussuto dhammadharo, bahussuto dhammadharoti bhante vuccati.
an4.186:4.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante bahussuto dhammadharo hotīti?
an4.186:4.7: bahu kho bhikkhu mayā dhammā desitā :
an4.186:4.8: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ.
an4.186:4.9: catuppadāya cepi bhikkhu gāthāya atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti bahussuto dhammadharoti alaṃ vacanāyāti.
an4.186:5.1: sādhu bhanteti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ aාpucchi :
an4.186:5.2: sutavā nibbedhikapañño, sutavā nibbedhikapaññoti bhante vuccati.
an4.186:5.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotīti?
an4.186:6.2: bhaddako kho te bhikkhu ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
an4.186:6.4: sutavā nibbedhikapañño, sutavā nibbedhikapaññoti bhante vuccati.
an4.186:6.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotīti?
an4.186:6.7: idha bhikkhu bhikkhuno idaṃ dukkhanti sutaṃ hoti, paññāya cassa atthaṃ ativijjha passati.
an4.186:6.8: ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti sutaṃ hoti, paññāya cassa atthaṃ ativijjha passati.
an4.186:6.9: ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti sutaṃ hoti, paññāya cassa atthaṃ ativijjha passati.
an4.186:6.10: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti sutaṃ hoti, paññāya cassa atthaṃ ativijjha passati.
an4.186:6.11: evaṃ kho bhikkhu sutavā nibbedhikapañño hotīti.
an4.186:7.1: sādhu bhante’ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ āpucchi :
an4.186:7.2: paṇḍito mahāpañño, paṇḍito mahāpañño’ti bhante vuccati.
an4.186:7.3: kittāvatā nu kho bhante paṇḍito mahāpañño hotīti?
an4.186:8.2: bhaddako kho te bhikkhu ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā.
an4.186:8.4: paṇḍito mahāpañño, paṇḍito mahāpañño’ti bhante vuccati.
an4.186:8.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante paṇḍito mahāpañño hotīti?
an4.186:8.7: idha bhikkhu paṇḍito mahāpañño nevattavyābādhāya ceteti, na paravyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayavyābādhāya ceteti. attahitaṃ parahitaṃ ubhayahitaṃ sabbalokahitameva cintayamāno cinteti.
an4.186:8.8: evaṃ kho bhikkhu paṇḍito mahāpañño hotīti.
